summary: Cannery is a self-hosted application designed for tracking firearms and ammunition inventory. As a niche inventory management tool, it helps private collectors or enthusiasts keep an organised digital record of their stock.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you specifically require a private, self-hosted database for tracking a firearm and ammunition collection rather than using generic spreadsheet software.
watchOut: The project currently has virtually no community activity, an unrated maintenance status, and no tagged releases, which implies you may encounter bugs or lack support.
deployNotes: Since it is distributed as a Docker container, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
